rule.sl:
**Tri besede** ostanejo skupaj, zaimek na koncu: **put up with** (prenašati), **run out of** (ostati brez), **get on with** (razumeti se z), **come up with** (domisliti se), **keep up with** (dohajati), **cut down on** (zmanjšati), **look up to** (občudovati), **look down on** (gledati zviška), **get away with** (ostati nekaznovan), **make up for** (nadoknaditi), **fall out with** (spreti se): **I can't put up with it.**

**look forward to** (veseliti se) + samostalnik ali -ing: **I look forward to seeing you.**

**Dve besedi, ostaneta skupaj:** **come across** (naleteti na), **take after** (biti podoben), **get over** (preboleti), **look into** (raziskati), **run into** (srečati), **go through** (pregledati): **I came across it.**

**Dve besedi, se razdelita:** **turn down** (zavrniti), **bring up** (vzgojiti), **work out** (ugotoviti), **call off** (odpovedati), **sort out** (urediti), **make up** (izmisliti si): **They called it off.**

Več pomenov: **go off** (pokvariti se), **turn up** (pojaviti se), **pick up** (naučiti se sproti), **put up** (prenočiti).
rule.de:
**Drei Wörter** bleiben zusammen, das Pronomen am Ende: **put up with** (ertragen), **run out of** (keins mehr haben), **get on with** (auskommen mit), **come up with** (sich ausdenken), **keep up with** (mithalten), **cut down on** (weniger verbrauchen), **look up to** (aufschauen zu), **look down on** (herabschauen auf), **get away with** (davonkommen), **make up for** (wettmachen), **fall out with** (sich zerstreiten): **I can't put up with it.**

**look forward to** (sich freuen auf) + Nomen oder -ing: **I look forward to seeing you.**

**Zwei Wörter, bleiben zusammen:** **come across** (zufällig finden), **take after** (geraten nach), **get over** (überwinden), **look into** (prüfen), **run into** (zufällig treffen), **go through** (durchgehen): **I came across it.**

**Zwei Wörter, werden getrennt:** **turn down** (ablehnen), **bring up** (großziehen), **work out** (herausfinden), **call off** (absagen), **sort out** (regeln), **make up** (erfinden): **They called it off.**

Mehrere Bedeutungen: **go off** (schlecht werden), **turn up** (auftauchen), **pick up** (nebenbei lernen), **put up** (unterbringen).
rule.it:
**Tre parole** restano unite, il pronome alla fine: **put up with** (sopportare), **run out of** (restare senza), **get on with** (andare d'accordo), **come up with** (farsi venire in mente), **keep up with** (stare al passo), **cut down on** (ridurre), **look up to** (ammirare), **look down on** (disprezzare), **get away with** (farla franca), **make up for** (compensare), **fall out with** (litigare): **I can't put up with it.**

**look forward to** (non vedere l'ora di) + un nome o -ing: **I look forward to seeing you.**

**Due parole, restano unite:** **come across** (imbattersi in), **take after** (assomigliare a), **get over** (riprendersi da), **look into** (esaminare), **run into** (incontrare per caso), **go through** (controllare): **I came across it.**

**Due parole, si dividono:** **turn down** (rifiutare), **bring up** (crescere), **work out** (capire), **call off** (annullare), **sort out** (sistemare), **make up** (inventare): **They called it off.**

Più significati: **go off** (andare a male), **turn up** (farsi vedere), **pick up** (imparare strada facendo), **put up** (ospitare).
rule.en:
**Three words** stay together, the pronoun last: **put up with** (accept something bad), **run out of** (have none left), **get on with** (be friends with), **come up with** (think of), **keep up with** (go as fast as), **cut down on** (use less), **look up to** (admire), **look down on** (think less of), **get away with** (not be punished for), **make up for** (make good), **fall out with** (quarrel with): **I can't put up with it.**

**look forward to** + a noun or -ing: **I look forward to seeing you.**

**Two words that stay together:** **come across** (find by chance), **take after** (be like), **get over** (get well after), **look into** (find out about), **run into** (meet by chance), **go through** (check): **I came across it.**

**Two words that part:** **turn down** (say no to), **bring up** (raise), **work out** (find the answer), **call off** (cancel), **sort out** (put right), **make up** (invent): **They called it off.**

Several meanings: **go off** (go bad), **turn up** (arrive), **pick up** (learn as you go), **put up** (give a bed).
